_about: default_rules.json — every default value baked into odm2html.py, plus inline documentation.
This file is for reference and as a starting point for customization. Copy it to e.g. rules.json,
delete anything you don't want to change, and pass with `-r rules.json`. User values deep-merge
over defaults: keys you omit keep the built-in default value.
JSON does not support comments, so docs are stored in keys prefixed with `_`. The renderer
ignores unknown keys, so `_doc_*` entries are inert at runtime.
See README.md for a complete configuration reference.
_doc_classes: CSS class names per element kind. Referenced from templates as `{class_<key>}`.
Change a value here to rename a class everywhere; change the CSS file to restyle.
Keys are FIXED — they're what templates look for. Values are free-form class strings.
_doc_templates: HTML snippet templates. Each value is a Python `str.format_map`-style template with
{placeholder} substitution. Missing placeholders render as empty strings (safe substitution),
so templates can omit any placeholder they don't need.
Every {class_<key>} from `classes` above is automatically available as a placeholder in
To override only one template in your own rules.json, include only that template name.
Deep-merge keeps every other template at its default.

_doc_dataTypeMap: ODM `DataType` attribute -> HTML <input type=...> in GENERIC (non-REDCap) mode.
Used when no `redcap:*` namespace is present in the source ODM file.
Unmapped DataType values fall through to `text`.
_doc_redcapValidationMap: REDCap `redcap:TextValidationType` -> HTML <input type=...> in REDCAP mode.
- everything else mapping to `number` -> input gets step="any"
Zipcode is rendered as text (with inputmode="numeric") plus the regex pattern
_doc_redcapWidgetMap: REDCap `redcap:FieldType` -> internal widget name. The renderer dispatches on the
internal name to choose a render function (and therefore a template).
checkbox      - Yes/No radio for isolated; otherwise collapsed checkbox group
Unmapped FieldType values fall through to `text`.
_doc_codeListAsRadioThreshold: GENERIC mode only. Codelists with <= N options render as radios; above N as <select>. Default 4. In REDCap mode this is ignored — `redcap:FieldType` decides.
_doc_includeFormTitle:
If true, emit

{form-name}

at the top of every form.
_doc_includeSectionHeaders:
If true, emit

{group-name}

for each ItemGroupDef with a non-empty Name. Empty group names produce no header regardless.
_doc_ignoreDefaultLength: If an ItemDef's Length attribute equals this string, do NOT emit a `maxlength` attribute. REDCap exports almost every text field as Length="999" (a sentinel for `no real limit`). Default "999". Set to "" to never skip.
_doc_submitButtonLabel: Text inside the submit button at the end of every form.
_doc_validation: html5            - (informational) HTML5 attributes (required, min, max, maxlength,
The bundled JS runtime defers to checkValidity() at submit time.
javascript       - If false, no `data-branch` or `data-calc` attributes are emitted
and the runtime no-ops their evaluation. HTML5 still applies.
branchingLogic   - If false, `redcap:BranchingLogic` is ignored at gen time.
calcAutoEval     - If false, `redcap:Calculation` is ignored at gen time (no data-calc).
customPatterns   - Map of REDCap `TextValidationType` -> regex (string). When a text
field has that vtype, the regex is emitted as pattern="...".
Keys here can be standard REDCap vtypes (ssn, mrn_10d, zipcode)
_doc_assets: Stylesheet and JS runtime source/destination control.
cssPath       - Path to a custom CSS file. Contents are written verbatim to
<prefix>.css. If null, the script's built-in default CSS is used.
jsPath        - Same, for the JS runtime. WARNING: if you replace it, you lose the
REDCap calc helpers (red_round, red_datediff, ...) and the
data-branch/data-calc evaluator. Either include those helpers in
your custom JS or disable validation.branchingLogic and
validation.calcAutoEval to stop emitting the attributes.
cssFilename   - Override the href in the <link> tag. Defaults to `<prefix>.css`.
Useful if every form should reference a single shared CSS at a fixed
_doc_fieldOverrides: Per-field customization. Keyed by — in order of preference — `redcap:Variable`,
then `ItemDef.Name`, then `OID`. The first match wins.
Each override entry can include any of:
templateOverrides : object — replace template(s) for this field only. Keys are
template names (item_text, item_select, ...). Values are full
template strings with the same {placeholder} substitution.
classOverrides    : object — replace class names for this field's templates. Keys
match `classes` (item, label, input, ...). Values are class
strings. Affects every {class_<key>} substitution for this
extraAttrs        : object — extra HTML attributes appended to the input/select/
textarea inside this field. Keys are attribute names, values
